with gemini on the PATH, setup runs:
  gemini mcp add --scope project factory roomctl mcp

otherwise: add this to .gemini/settings.json (roomctl setup never edits a config):

{
  "mcpServers": {
    "factory": {
      "command": "roomctl",
      "args": ["mcp"]
    }
  }
}

setup installs the factory-handoff skill in .gemini/skills
